theme.concept: Angular plates, vermilion banners and riveted frames.

labels.text: Round attribute halves up. Combat Order = (DEX + INT) / 2 - armour ENC.
* Record final ordinary damage, including applicable DM and Talents.
Use campaign ancestry starts and limits. For humans: start at 8, distribute 30, creation maximum 18.
IP SPENT: ANCESTRY / CHARACTERISTICS / SKILLS / TALENTS
Characteristics, pools, prerequisites, equipment and derived values checked
Above Capacity: -1P on physical and Fatigue tests; half Movement. Containers do not reduce ENC.
Include armour, weapons, containers and contents. Every 20 negligible items in a suitable container = 1 ENC.
Each cell is learned separately. Knowing one grants no other cell in that Form or Technique.
Active Magnitude cannot exceed permanent INT. Record each effect's full Magnitude and casting result.
Magnitude = sum of outcome Intensities + Range + Duration + Reach + adjustments.

Skills keep their scores when characteristics rise. Recalculate derived attributes after permanent changes.
